case_study_selection_note: Selected after discovery on 16 October 2026 from six candidates (Jaguar Land Rover, Asahi Group, Stryker, Boston Scientific, West Pharmaceutical Services, French refrigeration-controller compromise) using recency, sector relevance, EU/UK relevance, causal clarity, disclosed production and supplier outcome, disclosed financial and macro-economic outcome, government-support evidence, transferability and evidence quality. Jaguar Land Rover is the only in-period case with Tier 1 company filings, a national statistics office and central bank record of output effects, and a government loan guarantee. See 01_research_plan.md and report Chapter 5 selection matrix.
